facts.text: Serve the snacks when MacReady runs the blood test.
facts.why: MacReady proposes testing blood with a heated wire and restrains each man for it. Matches.

facts.text: Nobody eats until we've tested the blood. That's the rule for now, and I don't care who's offended.
facts.why: A note in MacReady's voice, not a quote. He takes command and runs the blood test, so it suits the plot, though nobody in the film talks about eating first. Keep it without quote marks. It is not printed on the single face.

facts.text: Windows checks the tin twice. Trust nobody.
facts.why: Windows is the radio operator in the film and 'trust nobody' is the film's tagline. Menu joke.

facts.text: MacReady's drink of choice, in a lolly.
facts.why: MacReady drinks Scotch (J&B), and shares a bottle with Childs in the last scene.

vibe.verdict: A good Outpost 31 ration sheet with the blood test and trust jokes, but the food is a standard menu with a few film names stuck on.
